sources.snippet: How do I run EpiCRealism NS? Create instantly in the Sogni app, or call the Sogni API with model id coreml-epiCRealismNaturalSin_nocn_6bit. Do I need a GPU or ComfyUI? No. EpiCRealism NS runs on the Sogni Supernet — a decentralized network of creator GPUs — with no local install or graphics card required.
